pattern: \b(?:framtid\w*|kommande generationer|våra barn och barnbarn|morgondagens|långsiktig\w*|på lång sikt|om (?:tio|tjugo|trettio|femtio|hundra) år|(?:år|till|fram till|inför) 20[2-9]0\b|vision\w*)
description_en: The marker for a future-oriented speech: the future, coming generations, a horizon of decades, long-term or a vision.
Technology, digitalisation, innovation, research and automation.
Solidarity, equality, redistribution and changing society together.
Careers, choice, entrepreneurship, lifelong learning and employability.
Climate, environment (not the Green Party, Miljöpartiet), sustainability, emissions and the green transition.
Crisis (also in compounds such as klimatkrisen; not names such as Kristersson), collapse, catastrophe and chaos.
Utopia, the good society, faith and hope in the future.

description_en: Cooperatives, shorter working hours, unconditional basic income (not SCB's basinkomst poverty measure), common ownership and economic democracy.
Security, safety, defence, preparedness, stability and crime.
Culture, the arts, Bildung and popular education, literature and libraries.
